svg.desc: Prepare two top layers with the selected short ligand. Ligand volume percent: 0.02 vol%; Ligand solution in acetonitrile Exchange duration: 10 s Top layer count: 2 layers Environment (inherited): Ambient atmosphere, 40–50% humidity, room temperature. General device-fabrication conditions; separate dry-air storage and vacuum Au deposition override them. Layer-by-layer branch. The source text names PbS–TBAI immersion; Figure 1b depicts spin casting PbS–OA for top layers. Do not infer an unreported top-layer spin speed. Conceptual material flow; apparatus geometry, liquid levels and particle shapes are not depicted.
